reviewer: episode_d1, independent second view of episode_e1 findings
kind: Actual production-r15 raw review, not a final decoded MP4 review

rows.finding: The mitten fingertips overlap the silver can/red printed band. The wooden tongs cannot be read as the tool grasping the hot can; the apparent direct grasp conflicts with the expressly required safe tongs operation.
rows.sourceEvidence: desk_d1v1.py244 rotates only the can root;252–254 translate tongs inX and position the original mitten. Their grasp transform is not coupled to the rotating can.
rows.proposedMinimalScope: Make existing wooden tong tips track the can during its unchanged inversion, and keep mitten on the handle with visible clearance from metal. Preserve original timing/voice/camera unless actual bounds require a local correction.

rows.finding: The valve/pipe remains floating above the central gap after both copper hemispheres have separated. It visibly does not remain attached to the released hemisphere.
rows.sourceEvidence: desk_d1v1.py283 transforms parts with release;285 adds only apart to valve and valvepipe, omitting release translation/rotation.
rows.proposedMinimalScope: Apply one released hemisphere's exact rigid transform to its existing valve and pipe. Do not add a new prop or change separation timing.
